items.title: Vijay has opened Tamil Nadu politics to a new breed of cinema heroes
items.sum: TVK leader Vijay launched his political party on February 2, 2024, altering Tamil Nadu's political landscape and shifting power toward cinema heroes. Vijay's strategy aims to weaken the DMK first family's control over the film industry and sideline the party politically. This shift has encouraged other contemporary actors to engage in social welfare outreach and education. Traditional political leaders like MK Stalin and Edappadi Palaniswami now face rising concern as actors move into politics. Meanwhile, TVK's official policies embrace a spiritual posture, marking a departure from traditional atheist Dravidianism.

items.title: Transgender Representation in Tamil Cinema Is Changing
items.sum: Karthik Subbaraj's film Dorothy centers on a transwoman with agency and self-determination, departing from decades of cinematic stereotypes in Tamil movies. Past films like Eeramana Rojave, Darbar, and I largely used transgender characters for comedy, humiliation, or as symbolic figures. Transwriter Agni Pradeep noted that older portrayals denied characters sovereignty over their lives, stating, trans characters have traditionally been denied the ability to make decisions for themselves.
items.hook: Karthik Subbaraj's Dorothy marks a shift in transgender representation in Tamil cinema

items.sum: Filmmaker R Gautham won the Best Debut Director award at the 2026 Asia Pacific Screen Awards for his film Members of a Complex Family. The movie centers on a young man's death and the subsequent funeral, examining family violence and complex emotions. The Berlin festival selection committee praised it as a wonderful debut film. The project also served as the opening film at the Melbourne Indian Film Festival, where it received nominations for Best Film and Best Director.
items.hook: Tamil filmmaker R Gautham wins Best Debut Director at Asia Pacific Screen Awards
